telemetryContract.terminals: One idempotent terminal event per observed span; carries start/duration even after ring eviction. Failure/cancellation/timeout and omitted active summaries do not strand owners.
telemetryContract.clocks: Durations computed within each monotonic/clamped context; browser timeOrigin metadata retained. Worker/server times are not subtracted from UI clocks. Backend timeOrigin is null.
telemetryContract.privacy: Scalar allowlist. No feature/image arrays, request URLs, review collections, job logs, Error objects/messages/stacks or environment dumps in the client report.
telemetryContract.memory: Bounded trace/index/profile ownership and logical bytes/admission estimates. No physical heap/native/GPU peak or sustained leak-free claim.
telemetryContract.resources: Existing model/request/worker/canvas/bitmap/spool ownership preserved. Diagnostics download uses existing delayed URL/allocation lease; build request owns a 5-second abortable deadline.

adoption.gate: Under 5% median added time on a repeatable local full-clip fixture; deterministic correctness/bounds in CI rather than wall-clock thresholds

measurement.method: Same realm, two warmups/mode and nine alternating full bounded-clip repetitions/mode; fixed 60ms model facade, synthetic cached tiles; GMD-017 profiling present in both

adoption.scope: Two warmups/mode, nine alternating runs/mode; cached synthetic imagery and fixed 60ms model facade, one window. GMD-017 profiling enabled in both modes. This is instrumentation cost, not real-model/live-network throughput.
adoption.p95: Nearest rank; with nine/five samples p95 is the maximum observation, not a stable long-tail estimate

provenance.executingEngine: Development literal in source; build writes full Git SHA to the one declared engine marker. Window/worker execute that stamp.
provenance.buildManifest: Versioned public source/model SHA-256, model bytes/input/class counts, pinned runtime and separate build timestamp. No environment dump.
provenance.browserMeaning: Matched means executing engine stamp equals artifact revision, not proof of every already-cached module. Worker/model mismatches are surfaced.
provenance.deploymentGuard: Source comparison accounts for deterministic stamp and validates selected revision/source/manifest digests plus model URL sizes/provenance. It does not re-download all model binaries solely to hash them.
provenance.backend: Coarse per-job server spans and logical NumPy/file bytes; live job API plus optional atomic sidecar, older folders remain readable. Source fingerprint is not Pages Git SHA; provider server does not assert GPU device.

old.dataset/TRAIN.md:
# Train and bring the model back to the portal

pip install ultralytics
cd dataset
yolo obb train data=data.yaml model=yolo11n-obb.pt imgsz=1024 epochs=50 batch=4
yolo export model=runs/obb/train/weights/best.pt format=onnx imgsz=1024 opset=17 simplify=True

Then in the portal: Detect > Load ONNX model > pick best.onnx.
Class names, in order: ship

No GPU? Upload this folder to Google Colab or Kaggle and run the same commands.

path: .
train: images/train
val: images/val
names:
  0: ship
